name: Velvet
description: A private library for your personal 18+ video collection. Pick folders on the NAS and get single-eye thumbnails for VR/180° side-by-side files, a frame strip to see what a scene contains, freeform tags with ratings, duplicate detection for re-downloads, and playback with a Left/Right/SBS eye switch. Files are indexed in place — nothing is copied and no content leaves the device.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.0.5: previews are ready before you ask — the detail poster reuses the left-eye still the grid already cached, and the six preview frames start generating while the pointer rests on a card, so opening a file no longer waits for ffmpeg; pending frames are checked every second instead of every three, and a still pulses while it is generated instead of showing the black placeholder. 1.0.4: deletes feel instant — the card disappears from the grid as soon as you confirm (it only comes back if the core reports a failure), the delete operation is checked after 150 ms instead of 700 ms, and the library is no longer reloaded after every delete; on a busy disk (thumbnail extraction, a running copy) a single-file delete could take several seconds before the grid updated. 1.0.3: opening Velvet now runs a quick incremental rescan by default — unchanged files skip ffprobe and per-row rewrites, so deletions or renames made while the window was closed are reflected immediately; restored files are un-marked without a probe, and Settings says “Quick rescan when Velvet opens”. 1.0.2: live File Manager sync — files deleted, trashed or renamed outside Velvet disappear from the library immediately through the core file-events WebSocket; their rows become Missing and cached stills are purged. Uploads and copies trigger a targeted rescan of the affected folder, a move one incremental scan. Velvet's own deletes are ignored by the bridge. 1.0.1: playback fixes — the player trusts the core's playback_mode, so multi-audio MP4s play directly instead of asking for an HLS session the core rejects; HLS sessions resume at the saved position with the correct absolute time; thumbnails retry while the service restarts and show a placeholder instead of a broken image. 1.0.0: first release — a private library for your own 18+ collection. Add folders with the EthOS picker, scan in place, and browse a thumbnail grid where VR side-by-side files show the left eye instead of a doubled frame. A detail view pairs six preview frames with ffprobe facts (per-eye dimensions, codec, bitrate, duration, size), freeform tags, a 1–5 rating and keep/reject marks. Duplicates are grouped by cleaned title and comparable runtime so re-downloads can be removed in bulk. Playback reuses the core Video Station pipeline (direct streaming or HLS for HEVC/MKV) with Left / Right / SBS eye switching, quality, audio tracks, speed and resume. Every account has its own index, tags and thumbnails; permanent deletion goes through the core file API behind a typed confirmation.
